text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ

translations.asad: WHEN THE SKY is cleft asunder,
and when the stars are scattered,
translations.sahih: And when the stars fall, scattering,

translations.asad: and when the seas burst beyond their bounds,
translations.sahih: And when the seas are erupted

translations.asad: and when the graves are overturned –
translations.sahih: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered,

translations.asad: every human being will [at last] comprehend, what he has sent ahead and what he has held back [in this world].
translations.sahih: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.

text.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ

translations.asad: O MAN! What is it that lures thee away from thy bountiful Sustainer,
translations.sahih: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,

translations.asad: who has created thee, and formed thee in accordance with what thou art meant' to be, and shaped thy nature in just proportions,
translations.sahih: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?

text.arabic: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ

translations.asad: having put thee together in whatever form He willed [thee to have]?
translations.sahih: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.

translations.asad: Nay, [O men,] but you [are lured away from God whenever you are tempted to] give the lie to [God’s] Judgment!
translations.sahih: No! But you deny the Recompense.

translations.asad: And yet, verily, there are ever-watchful forces over you,
translations.sahih: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,

translations.asad: Behold, [in the life to come] the truly virtuous: will indeed be in bliss,
translations.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,

translations.asad: whereas, behold, the wicked will indeed be in a blazing fire –
translations.sahih: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.

translations.asad: [a fire] which they shall enter on Judgment Day,
translations.sahih: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,

translations.asad: and which they shall not [be able to] evade.
translations.sahih: And never therefrom will they be absent.

translations.asad: And what could make thee conceive what that Judgment Day will be?
translations.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

text.arabic: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ

translations.asad: And once again: What could make thee conceive what that Judgment Day will be?
translations.sahih: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

text.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ

translations.asad: [It will be] a Day when no human being shall be of the least avail to another human being: for on that Day [it will become manifest that] all sovereignty is God's alone.
translations.sahih: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah.
